newsitem.title: CROATIA: TENNIS-MAJOLI AIMS TO BE WORLD NUMBER TWO.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MAJOLI AIMS TO BE WORLD NUMBER TWO.

text.p: French Open champion Iva Majoli said on Wednesday her goal was to be second in the world by the end of the season.
The 19-year-old Croat is currently ranked fourth by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) and is second in the year's earnings list, after Wimbledon champion Martina Hingis.
"I am fourth now and my goal is to climb to second place, as close as possible to Martina Hingis," Majoli said in an interview in the Globus weekly on Wednesday.
"Last year I used only half of my capacity during training. Now I approach every training with 100 per cent force and concentration," she said.
A right-handed and energetic player who prefers to stay at the baseline, Majoli won her first Grand Slam title at Roland Garros by beating 16-year-old Swiss Hingis in the final.
Their head-to-head tally now stands at 2-2.

"I am sure Martina and I will play good matches... The audience wants rivalry, like the one between Martina Navratilova and Chris Evert-Lloyd, or Steffi Graf and Monica Seles," Majoli told the weekly.
